capture.driver: Playwright 1.63.0 Chromium 153.0.8010.12, device scale 1, normal service worker behavior
capture.fonts: self-hosted Space Grotesk bundled in web/dist; Space Grotesk loaded: true
capture.server: disposable .browser/server embedding this web/dist; owned temporary SQLite data; KEEP_FIXTURE=1 retains it for Computer Use until SIGTERM
capture.fixture: synthetic: admin account; three watched apps (Billing API ok, Mail relay degraded, Backup agent down) served by a capture-owned fake health endpoint on a private bridge address. Durations and timestamps are live and differ between runs

provenance.capture_history: Initial helper failed to locate Backup; corrected to Backup & recovery before successful32 captures. No UI/source change. Parent logs /tmp/kypulse-eight-baseline-capture.log and /tmp/kypulse-eight-baseline-capture-final.log; these logs were not independently read.

verdict.scope: Visual8 progression for20 admin-console and12 settings unique initial-viewport synthetic admin captures; separate cohorts; no full-product behavioral acceptance.
verdict.reason: Admin-console remains below8, driven by phone alert/event/filter composition and competing action emphasis. Settings meets8 on its covered-cohort mean; no pooled score can clear the other cohort. Four Status dimension rows carry the disclosed blind-transcription limitation.

findings.title: Compact the global AlertBar chronology on phones while keeping every problem represented
findings.observation: The 125px phone header is followed by a roughly134px global band for only two problems: long underlined absolute-date links and a separate Alerts line. This repeats app-specific Down content on detail and takes priority above every configuration view.
findings.fix: Give each global problem a short app/state/age lead, with the full since/cause information in subordinate wrapping metadata; keep problem links and the Alerts destination. Arrange Alerts alongside the summary rather than as a separate full-width line where space permits. Preserve problem meaning, delivery/stale notices, roles and the rule that silencing outbound messages never hides the problem. Keep the app-detail health panel diagnostic and prominent; it is a different component.

findings.title: Make Logs and Activity filters a deliberate responsive grid
findings.observation: Three short inputs each occupy a separate phone row at about196px width inside a358px content column; both date bounds follow. Desktop wraps only To and actions while the source-origin field truncates its placeholder. These are inefficient captured layouts, not proof of unreachable results.
findings.fix: Use an explicit filter grid: compact compatible fields together at390px, full-width text/date fields when needed, and one action row; align date bounds together on desktop. Give the source HTTPS origin flexible width. Preserve explicit Apply/Clear semantics and all UTC, retention and transport help.

findings.title: Make reset and refresh secondary actions
findings.observation: Apply and Clear have identical orange fills; Logs adds equally filled Add source and Refresh sources. Separate tasks lack a clear leading action.
findings.fix: Keep Apply and Add source primary within their respective groups; apply existing btn-secondary to Clear and Refresh sources. Keep labels, event handlers and permissions.

findings.title: Present complete event summaries without split transition labels on phones
findings.observation: pending → degraded breaks across three lines and Delivery is beyond the initial horizontal table view. Native inspection confirms the table scrolls internally; this is not an unreachable column or document overflow claim.
